orchestrator.finalText:
Here is the dispatch brief for the Conveyor Cell orchestration:

- **`plc-coder`**: Tasked with writing the IEC 61131-3 Structured Text for the OpenPLC Runtime v4 to implement the state latching, timers (dwell, jam, and cooldown), counters (batch tracking), interlocks, and the corresponding Modbus TCP master configuration strictly based on the canonical `io-contract.json`.
- **`oip-builder`**: Tasked with using the OIP CLI headlessly to scaffold the 3D cell—wiring the spawner, conveyor, photo-eye, buttons, and lamps to their correct part mappings (`belt_1.runTag`, `spawner_1.runTag`, etc.) to exact `io-contract.json` specifications.
- **`test-engineer`**: Tasked with authoring STruC++ scan-cycle unit tests for the PLC logic, strict OIP validators for the 3D scene parameters, and launching live Modbus TCP E2E tests to verify edge behaviors like EStop interlocks and anti-touching cooldowns.

workers.finalText: Authored `openplc/conveyor_cell.st`, `scenes/conveyor-cell/plc/program.st`, and derived `openplc/conveyor_cell_modbus_master.json` strictly matching the canonical `io-contract.json` specifications and verified zero errors with STruC++ compilation and unit tests.
Conveyor Cell scene `scenes/conveyor-cell/scene.json` has been authored and verified against `openplc/io-contract.json`, passing all strict OIP project, wiring, and layout validations.
Authored STruC++ scan-cycle test suite in `tests/conveyor_cell.test.st` validating all 7 ConveyorCellController behaviors with 7 passing tests and zero failures.

I restored `openplc/io-contract.json` to its complete canonical structure and ran the suite to confirm. 

All checks pass on the exact integration worktree:
- `test:contract` (PASS - 13/13 tests)
- `plc:test` (PASS - 7/7 tests)
- `oip:validate` (PASS - ST compiled, tags wired, layout valid)
- `test:e2e` (PASS - 3/3 tests)

Both `openplc/conveyor_cell.st` and `scenes/conveyor-cell/plc/program.st` remain untouched and byte-identical.
